headline: Deloitte's AI Advisory Is Actually Hurting Revenue Growth
summary: Deloitte's AI advisory business is weighing on its overall revenue growth rate, confirmed in a Bloomberg Tax note this week. The same week, Accenture's stock rose 6% on its $1 billion Anthropic partnership. The divergence maps directly to a structural difference: Accenture has a deployment and implementation relationship with a frontier model provider; Deloitte has advisory capability without the same technical tether. For healthcare consulting practices, the signal is that strategy-only AI advisory is losing economics to strategy-plus-implementation models anchored in specific vendor relationships.
so_what: Deloitte's AI advisory business is actively dragging down its revenue growth rate, not accelerating it. At the same time, Accenture gained 6% on its Anthropic partnership. The AI advisory economics at the top consulting firms are diverging, and this week made it visible.
